shipped_rows.title_o: Prenatal stress may increase vulnerability to life events: Comparison with the effects of prenatal dexamethasone
shipped_rows.authors_o: Hougaard; Andersen; Kjær; Hansen; Werge; Lund

blind_target.evidence_quote: We have previously observed increased basal acoustic startle response (ASR) in Wistar rats exposed to stress or dexamethasone (DEX) in utero when tested during the light phase of the circadian rhythm, and decreased prepulse inhibition (PPI) in similar animals tested during the dark phase of the cycle.
blind_target.outcome_quote: We hereby replicated our earlier findings in a new strain and laboratory, thus strengthening the validity of our model regarding prenatal stress effects on ASR in female offspring.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall replication verdict. Original bibliographic identity and number of original papers cannot be resolved from abstract; unnamed target represents the earlier basal-startle finding, not an inferred reference.

Need the original citation/reference associated with the ASR finding, plus confirmation of equivalence to row 1539 if applicable.
